title: General-SPD counterexample and worst-case search
objective: Search for matrices violating C001 or exposing weakness in C010, while preserving reproducible candidates and best non-violating margins.
acceptance_checks: Covers structured, random correlation, block and nearly singular families.
Preserves every candidate matrix and generation seed.
Recomputes negative margins with an independent formulation.
Does not call a no-hit search a proof.
